title: Ivanti Connect Secure: attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 25 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access. The exploit prediction score is 89%.

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 16, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
